purpose.summary: This program generates public-expense (Kouhi) medical billing claim documents (seikyu-sho, item 145) for the JMA ORCA standard receipt software system. It reads indexed patient/insurance files, processes billing data for long-term care and outpatient/inpatient combinations, and writes formatted claim output and error files.
